title: From RAG to Agentic RAG for Faithful Islamic Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model accuracy, hallucination, and abstention rates across parallel Arabic and English queries within the ISLAMICFAITHQA benchmark to identify performance asymmetries and cross-lingual disparities.

Evaluating the faithfulness, groundedness, and hallucination rates of general-purpose LLMs on Islamic jurisprudence and theological questions using a strict LLM-as-a-judge protocol, aiming to highlight and mitigate representational gaps and Western-centric alignment effects in value-laden domains.
